ADU218 relay K0 switching transcript, with an independent witness
================================================================
Device: Ontrak ADU218, USB 0a07:00da, node /dev/bus/usb/001/015
Witness: SDM4065A s/n SDM46A0CA00021 fw 0.0.0.20
Wiring: K0 load side -> DMM input leads. Nothing else attached.
Settle: 0.5 s after each command, covering SSR turn-on plus DMM
        integration time.

Three independent readings per transition: the relay's own bit
(RPK0), the whole port (PK), and the DMM. The DMM is the only one
of the three that is not the device reporting on itself.

initial: PK=000 RPK0=0 WD=0 DB=1

===== CYCLE 1 =====
-- commanding K0 CLOSED (SK0) --
   ADU218 reports  RPK0=1  PK=001
   DMM measures    6.1398 ohm
-- commanding K0 OPEN (RK0) --
   ADU218 reports  RPK0=0  PK=000
   DMM measures    OPEN (9.9E37 overload sentinel)

===== CYCLE 2 =====
-- commanding K0 CLOSED (SK0) --
   ADU218 reports  RPK0=1  PK=001
   DMM measures    6.1395 ohm
-- commanding K0 OPEN (RK0) --
   ADU218 reports  RPK0=0  PK=000
   DMM measures    OPEN (9.9E37 overload sentinel)

===== SUMMARY =====
  cycle1 commanded=closed RPK0=1 PK=001 DMM=6.1398 ohm               adu_self_consistent=True
  cycle1 commanded=open   RPK0=0 PK=000 DMM=OPEN(inf)                adu_self_consistent=True
  cycle2 commanded=closed RPK0=1 PK=001 DMM=6.1395 ohm               adu_self_consistent=True
  cycle2 commanded=open   RPK0=0 PK=000 DMM=OPEN(inf)                adu_self_consistent=True

The open state raises an overload rather than returning a number,
so open-vs-closed discrimination needs no threshold at all: the
margin between ~6 ohm and the overload sentinel is effectively
infinite. A driver should treat the DMM's overload as 'open', not
compare against a resistance limit.
